dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また」
dialogues.en: "Later."
dialogues.text: "Later."

dialogues.jp:
ことりと同じように手を振る。ともちゃんとみっ
くんは、ぺこんと頭を下げ、去っていった。
dialogues.en:
I waved along with Kotori. Tomo-chan and Mik-kun bowed once,
then left.
dialogues.text:
I waved along with Kotori. Tomo-chan and Mik-kun bowed once,
then left.

dialogues.jp:
部屋の使用時間いっぱいまで使った練習は、こ
れにて終了となった訳だ。
dialogues.en:
We had used up the room to the full extent of our reserved
time, which was over now.
dialogues.text:
We had used up the room to the full extent of our reserved
time, which was over now.

dialogues.jp: 「いつも、ここで別れるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Do you three always seperate here?"
dialogues.text: "Do you three always seperate here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい。家が、まるっきり反対側なんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Our houses are on opposite sides."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Our houses are on opposite sides."

dialogues.jp: ことりは校舎の方を振り返った。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked back at the school.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked back at the school.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私の家は島の北西側で──」
dialogues.en: "My home is at the northwestern part of the island--"
dialogues.text: "My home is at the northwestern part of the island--"

dialogues.jp: くるりとこちらを振り返る。
dialogues.en: She turned her head to face the front again.
dialogues.text: She turned her head to face the front again.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あのふたりは、北東側なんです。だから、寄
　り道しない時はここでバイバイですね」
dialogues.en:
"The other two stays at the northeast. We don't take the
same route, so we say goodbye here."
dialogues.text:
"The other two stays at the northeast. We don't take the
same route, so we say goodbye here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あのふたりが一番の仲良しなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "They're your closest friends, aren't they?"
dialogues.text: "They're your closest friends, aren't they?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。ちっちゃい頃からの友達です」
dialogues.en: "That's right. We've been friends since we were kids."
dialogues.text: "That's right. We've been friends since we were kids."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの目がすっと遠くなる。桜並木を遠ざか
るふたりの背中を見つめているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's eyes looked distant. No doubt they were straining
to try and see the back of the two, who had left down the
avenue.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's eyes looked distant. No doubt they were straining
to try and see the back of the two, who had left down the
avenue.

dialogues.jp:
（仲良し３人組で、ひとりだけ住んでる場所が
　違うってのも、寂しいかもしれないな）
dialogues.en:
"(In a group of three close friends, when one lives in a
different place from the other two, the one must feel really
lonely...)"
dialogues.text:
"(In a group of three close friends, when one lives in a
different place from the other two, the one must feel really
lonely...)"

dialogues.jp:
昔、幼なじみをアメリカに失った身としては、
ついそんな事を思ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I thought back to my own past, where my own childhood friend
had did the same thing and left the two of us.
dialogues.text:
I thought back to my own past, where my own childhood friend
had did the same thing and left the two of us.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、帰ってきたら帰ってきたで、かったるい
のも事実だけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, she did come back, and that's the... unfortunate
truth.
dialogues.text:
Well, she did come back, and that's the... unfortunate
truth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、今は、朝倉君が居てくれますからね」
dialogues.en: "But I have you now."
dialogues.text: "But I have you now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何の話？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What was that about?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What was that about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「独り言です」
dialogues.en: "Oh, just talking to myself."
dialogues.text: "Oh, just talking to myself."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、今から桜公園まで付き合ってもらえ
　ませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, can we go to the Sakura Park for a bit?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, can we go to the Sakura Park for a bit?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、別にいいけど」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, no problems here."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, no problems here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、早速、れっつらゴーです」
dialogues.en: "Then let's go there quickly!"
dialogues.text: "Then let's go there quickly!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、公園で何するんだ？　ひなたぼっこ？
　花見？」
dialogues.en:
"What do you need to do at the park though? Sunbathing?
Flower-viewing?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you need to do at the park though? Sunbathing?
Flower-viewing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、お花見っていいですね。今度、やりませ
　ん？　お弁当作ってきますから」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, flower-viewing would be good. Maybe next time? I'd make
a lunchbox for that as well."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, flower-viewing would be good. Maybe next time? I'd make
a lunchbox for that as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お、そりゃいいね……けど、まあ、今度の話
　は置いておいて。今は？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, that'd be good... but, well, save next time's talk for
next time. What about now?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, that'd be good... but, well, save next time's talk for
next time. What about now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「歌の練習をしようと思うんです。あの場所で」
dialogues.en:
"I thought maybe I'd go...there... and practice singing some
more."
dialogues.text:
"I thought maybe I'd go...there... and practice singing some
more."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……あの場所。ああ、あそこな」
dialogues.en: "...There? ...Oh, that place."
dialogues.text: "...There? ...Oh, that place."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「みっくんもともちゃんも、お家で練習してい
　るはずですからね。私だけサボれないです」
dialogues.en:
"Mik-kun and Tomo-chan practice their parts at home as well.
I can't let myself fall behind."
dialogues.text:
"Mik-kun and Tomo-chan practice their parts at home as well.
I can't let myself fall behind."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そういや、ちくっと気になったんだけど、な
　んでみっ“くん”なの？」
dialogues.en:
"Speaking of that, I was wondering something. Why do you
call her "Mik-kun"?
dialogues.text:
"Speaking of that, I was wondering something. Why do you
call her "Mik-kun"?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あ、う〜ん……言っちゃっていいのか
　な……？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah, hmm... would it be all right to explain...?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah, hmm... would it be all right to explain...?"

dialogues.jp:
困ったように首を傾げる。と、その瞳がきらり
と光った。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked perplexed as she tried to decide.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked perplexed as she tried to decide.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いっか。みっくんだって、あの事ばら
　しちゃったし……」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, it should be okay. Besides, I could consider it as a
bit of revenge for that..."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, it should be okay. Besides, I could consider it as a
bit of revenge for that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: （あの事？）

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何よ？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごほん……それでですね、みっくんの由来で
　すけど……」
dialogues.en: "Ahem... thus, I will explain the origin of "Mik-kun"..."
dialogues.text: "Ahem... thus, I will explain the origin of "Mik-kun"..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お、おう」
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.jp: 何か言いたげだったのに、話が進んでしまった。
dialogues.en:
I'm not exactly sure what happened, but apparently she's
made her decision.
dialogues.text:
I'm not exactly sure what happened, but apparently she's
made her decision.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「彼女には、｛みきひこ／幹彦｝って名前のお兄さんが居て、
　そこから取ってるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Her real name is Mikihiko, and her brother gave her that
nickname. Since then, she's requested everyone who knows her
to use it."
dialogues.text:
"Her real name is Mikihiko, and her brother gave her that
nickname. Since then, she's requested everyone who knows her
to use it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「は？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "Haah? Why?"
dialogues.text: "Haah? Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「みっくんは、お兄ちゃんが好きなんですよ。
　ていうか、大好きなんです。ううん、鬼のよ
　うに好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "Because she likes her brother... reaaaally likes him."
dialogues.text: "Because she likes her brother... reaaaally likes him."

dialogues.jp: そして、あの場所についた。
dialogues.en: We then reached "that place".
dialogues.text: We then reached "that place".

dialogues.jp: かつて、秘密基地と呼んでいた場所。
dialogues.en: The place I once called my secret base.
dialogues.text: The place I once called my secret base.

dialogues.jp:
あの頃と同じように桜が植わっていて。あの頃
と同じように、花びらを舞い散らせている。
dialogues.en:
Just like that time, the huge Sakura tree stood firm. Just
like that time, the sakura petals danced around the area.
dialogues.text:
Just like that time, the huge Sakura tree stood firm. Just
like that time, the sakura petals danced around the area.

dialogues.jp:
違いと言ったら、最近になって知り合ったこと
りが、そばに居る事だけ。
dialogues.en:
The only difference this time was the person by my side,
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
The only difference this time was the person by my side,
Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私にとっても、お気に入りの場所です……」
dialogues.en: "I've always liked it here..."
dialogues.text: "I've always liked it here..."

dialogues.jp:
さくさくと草を踏みしめ、ひときわ太い桜の木
へと近づいていく。
dialogues.en:
We crunched our way through the grasses and leaves, getting
closer to the huge sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
We crunched our way through the grasses and leaves, getting
closer to the huge sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ここって……静かなせいか、とても落ち着け
　るんですよね……」
dialogues.en: "It's so... peaceful out here, it calms me..."
dialogues.text: "It's so... peaceful out here, it calms me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……だから、練習には持ってこいの場所って
　事？」
dialogues.en: "...And that's why you come here to practice?"
dialogues.text: "...And that's why you come here to practice?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Uh huh."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh."

dialogues.jp:
幹に手の平をあて、こくんとうなずく。歌うた
めに、ことりはマスクを取っていた。
dialogues.en:
She placed her palm on the tree lightly, nodding to my
question. She then took off her mask, preparing to sing.
dialogues.text:
She placed her palm on the tree lightly, nodding to my
question. She then took off her mask, preparing to sing.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、人が居るのは苦手なんですよね。
　今日の音楽室とかも……」
dialogues.en:
"...I guess I still can't sing in front of lots of people...
after that situation today in the music room..."
dialogues.text:
"...I guess I still can't sing in front of lots of people...
after that situation today in the music room..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、あいつらはな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, that wasn't your fault..."
dialogues.text: "Well, that wasn't your fault..."

dialogues.jp: 今思い出してもムカムカしてくる。
dialogues.en: Just remembering today made me feel angry at those bastards.
dialogues.text: Just remembering today made me feel angry at those bastards.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、きちんと楽器と合わせないといけませ
　んから。我慢して続けてたんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"But I still can't time my singing right with the
instruments. I have to keep practicing until I get it
right..."
dialogues.text:
"But I still can't time my singing right with the
instruments. I have to keep practicing until I get it
right..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「明日からは心配ご無用。俺が全部追い出すか
　ら」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry about tomorrow. I'd chase every single one of
them out if they dare come in."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry about tomorrow. I'd chase every single one of
them out if they dare come in."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「頼りにしてまっす」
dialogues.en: "I'd be relying on you."
dialogues.text: "I'd be relying on you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うむ。震えるチワワのように頼ってくれたま
　え」
dialogues.en:
"Of course. I'd make them shiver like a frightened
chihuahua!"
dialogues.text:
"Of course. I'd make them shiver like a frightened
chihuahua!"

dialogues.jp: 腕を組み、重々しくうなずく。
dialogues.en: I jokingly flex a bit, while nodding to her request.
dialogues.text: I jokingly flex a bit, while nodding to her request.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さて」
dialogues.en: "Now then."
dialogues.text: "Now then."

dialogues.jp: 小さく呟き、ことりは姿勢を正した。
dialogues.en: Kotori murmured softly, and straightened her posture.
dialogues.text: Kotori murmured softly, and straightened her posture.

dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　今さらだけど、ここに来たのって、
　歌の練習をするからだよな？」
dialogues.en:
"Uhh... didn't you say just now that you came here to
practice singing?"
dialogues.text:
"Uhh... didn't you say just now that you came here to
practice singing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですよ」
dialogues.en: "Uh huh."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh."

dialogues.jp: きょとんとして、ことりがうなずく。
dialogues.en: Kotori innocently nodded.
dialogues.text: Kotori innocently nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「……って、俺が居ていいの？　確か前に会っ
　た時、気が散るからって……」
dialogues.en:
"...Then is it really alright if I stay here? The last time,
you were disturbed by me..."
dialogues.text:
"...Then is it really alright if I stay here? The last time,
you were disturbed by me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、う〜ん、そんな事もありましたっけ」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh~, weeell, that's true."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh~, weeell, that's true."

dialogues.jp: てへへと、頭をこつんとやる。
dialogues.en: Giggling slightly, Kotori shook her head lightly.
dialogues.text: Giggling slightly, Kotori shook her head lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、まあ、あの時はあの時ですし、今は今
　ですよ」
dialogues.en: "But, well, that time was that time, and now is now."
dialogues.text: "But, well, that time was that time, and now is now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Haah."
dialogues.text: "...Haah."

dialogues.jp: 分かるような分からんような。
dialogues.en: I don't understand her sometimes.
dialogues.text: I don't understand her sometimes.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃあ、俺はここに居ていいんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So it'd be okay if I stay here?"
dialogues.text: "So it'd be okay if I stay here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……嫌じゃ、ないですよね？」
dialogues.en: "...It's okay with you, right?"
dialogues.text: "...It's okay with you, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「マネージャーとしては、嫌とは言えんな」
dialogues.en: "I'm your manager, I won't say no."
dialogues.text: "I'm your manager, I won't say no."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君個人としては？」
dialogues.en: "What about Asakura-kun, the person?"
dialogues.text: "What about Asakura-kun, the person?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、個人としても」
dialogues.en: "...Well, the person too."
dialogues.text: "...Well, the person too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "OK."
dialogues.text: "OK."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私としては朝倉君に居て欲しいなって、そう
　思ったから……。だから、ここまで付き合っ
　てもらったんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I think that I want you to be here... so please wait for me
here."
dialogues.text:
"I think that I want you to be here... so please wait for me
here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ではでは、ことり、行っきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Anyway. Kotori, heading out~"
dialogues.text: "Anyway. Kotori, heading out~"

dialogues.jp:
どこぞのパイロットの真似をすると、ことりは
ぴしゃんと姿勢を正した。
dialogues.en:
Mimicking a line from some giant robot pilot of some sort,
Kotori straightened her posture once again.
dialogues.text:
Mimicking a line from some giant robot pilot of some sort,
Kotori straightened her posture once again.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうそう。途中で暇になっちゃったら、
　帰ってくれて構わないですからね」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, by the way, if you get bored in the middle, please
don't leave or anything..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, by the way, if you get bored in the middle, please
don't leave or anything..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「歌い始めたら、私、何も分かりませんから」
dialogues.en:
"When I start singing, I forget everything that's happening
in the real world."
dialogues.text:
"When I start singing, I forget everything that's happening
in the real world."

dialogues.jp:
何げに凄い事をさらりと言ってのけると、こと
りは歌う体勢に入った。
dialogues.en:
After giving me a light warning, Kotori returned to her
singing posture.
dialogues.text:
After giving me a light warning, Kotori returned to her
singing posture.

dialogues.jp:
目には見えない、何かオーラのようなものをま
とった雰囲気。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes were closed. The atmosphere was filled with an aura
she was emnating.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes were closed. The atmosphere was filled with an aura
she was emnating.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ぽそりと呟いた。
dialogues.en: I silently muttered.
dialogues.text: I silently muttered.

dialogues.jp: 「……居るよ」
dialogues.en: "...I'd be here."
dialogues.text: "...I'd be here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分かりました」
dialogues.en: "Understood."
dialogues.text: "Understood."

dialogues.jp: 目をつむる。歌声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes, and began to listen to her song.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes, and began to listen to her song.

dialogues.jp:
公園に住む動物達が、｛ひ／惹｝かれ、集まってきてし
まうのではないか──そんな幻想。
dialogues.en:
I started seeing illusions-- like all the animals of the
park had gathered around to hear her song.
dialogues.text:
I started seeing illusions-- like all the animals of the
park had gathered around to hear her song.

dialogues.jp: ◆練習の後１◆
dialogues.en: ◆After Practice 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆After Practice 1◆

dialogues.jp:
音楽室での練習が終わった後。俺は、ことりに
誘われて、一緒に桜公園へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
The scene was after practice in the music room. I was
incited by Kotori to go to the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
The scene was after practice in the music room. I was
incited by Kotori to go to the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
歌の練習に来たのだという。俺達は、早速桜の
大木へ行った。
dialogues.en:
The reason was to practice her singing. We quickly went to
the huge sakura tree in the middle of the park.
dialogues.text:
The reason was to practice her singing. We quickly went to
the huge sakura tree in the middle of the park.
